prerequisites: Author and independently review honest oracle deliverables; neither domain ships an oracle.

Provide a version-aware Maverick deployment accepting the fixed Novita-qualified model ID and reporting model_revision exactly 94125d2bd83076b21eed33119525e29eaf3894f4. The public HF router does not document this capability; do not fake the field in a forwarding shim.
Resolve or explicitly exclude the measured general rule runtime failures listed by task/item in the census.
Obtain Peter's paid-call approval for the exact bounded spec and actual deployment quote; catalogue router rates are not a quote for a new version-aware deployment.

sampling.selection: deterministic evenly spaced sorted task names; first four eligible text atoms per general task, not a full-domain qualification

reporting: every item score and mask separately
input/output token usage and billed spend
structural gate failures versus infrastructure masks
webdev.warning: Keyword presence is necessary, not sufficient. Visible keyword dumps can pass these gates and must be rejected by independent semantic controls.

stop_rules: No initial paid call until the prerequisites and approval are satisfied.
Run a 10-atom/10-page three-repeat pilot before expansion; stop on wrong revision, oracle rejection, structural false rejection or mask rate above 5%.
Concurrency 1, at most four transport attempts per judgment, no hidden judge fallback.
Record provider usage after each response and debit all attempts. Recompute the quote after the pilot; stop before the next call when it would cross the approved spend ceiling.

cost_projection.units: USD per million tokens, no HF markup
cost_projection.limits: These are projections, not billed results or a hard upper bound: actual image token accounting, retry token charges and version-aware endpoint rates are unmeasured. The four-attempt figure assumes the stated token sizes on every attempt. Credits were not counted as free money. Refresh rates and quote the actual endpoint before seeking approval.
